comments.text: Behaviour change / security-relevant regression: the deep copy of OAuth2.Providers was removed. `alias` is a shallow struct copy, so alias.OAuth2.Providers shares its backing array with the Collection being serialized. Setting `alias.OAuth2.Providers[i].ClientSecret = ""` now wipes the real client secrets on the source model, including the app's cached collection (FindCachedCollectionByNameOrId). After any JSON serialization the in-memory OAuth2 config loses its secrets, breaking OAuth2 sign-in until a cache reload, and a subsequent save of that instance can persist empty secrets. The token secrets are plain strings in a value copy, so those are fine; only the slice is affected. Please restore the copy before redacting.
TestCollectionSerializeNotModifyingCache is exactly the regression test that guards this and would fail with the new code; it must not be deleted.
